sections.title: About
sections.intro: I am a passionate Software Engineer with a Master’s degree in Software Engineering from FAST National University (2022–2024). My thesis, “Automated Testing of Microservices Using Evolutionary Algorithms,” harnessed Python and machine learning to optimize testing for distributed systems. Skilled in Python, Django, PostgreSQL, RESTful APIs, and XML, I have engineered scalable ERP systems. Eager to advance AI-driven research, I am committed to pursuing a PhD to innovate in computational social science and intelligent systems.

profile.shortIntro: A result driven, customer focused and statistics based enthusiastic, passionate and dedicated professional software engineer, having Master’s degree in software engineering.
profile.bio: I build reliable, scalable backend systems with Python, Django, and Odoo. My work spans ERP for healthcare and education, RESTful service design, and data‑intensive reporting with PostgreSQL and XML/OWL. My research mindset comes from my MS at FAST‑NUCES, where I built an evolutionary microservices testing framework. I value clean code, pragmatic architecture, and fast feedback through reviews and demos.
profile.summary: Software Engineer specialized in Python and Odoo, building ERP and data-centric solutions with Django, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and XML/OWL. Passionate about code quality, agile delivery, and applied research.
